questions.q: Why is a DP-700 study plan mostly a 'review' schedule rather than a 'first-pass through new material' schedule?
options: Because the three exam domains map directly onto chapters already covered in this course and the Fabric/Databricks courses
Because DP-700 covers entirely new material not taught anywhere in this track
Because study plans are unnecessary for any Microsoft certification
Because Domain 3 is the only domain that requires studying
questions.explain: Lesson 27 mapped all three domains onto specific chapters already taken — the plan is about drilling that material, not learning it fresh.

questions.q: In the suggested 4-week plan, what happens in Week 3?
options: Domain 3 review, the security and monitoring practice sets, and a re-read of the traps lesson
The first full-length mock exam, with no prior review
Domain 1 review only
Registering for the exam
questions.explain: Week 3 pairs Domain 3's material with Lessons 35-36's practice sets and a repeat read of Lesson 37's trap list.

questions.q: What should happen in the two days after each Week 4 mock exam?
options: Re-reading every missed question, and returning to the original Fabric or Databricks lesson when the gap is conceptual, not just a test-taking issue
Immediately retaking the same mock exam with no review
Skipping review entirely and moving to the next domain
Only reading the quiz explanation text, never the original lesson
questions.explain: The plan specifically calls for going back to the source lesson when a missed question reveals a concept gap, not just an exam-technique slip.

questions.q: If you have less than four weeks before your exam, what does the lesson recommend?
options: Compress Weeks 1-3, but never skip the Week 4 mock exams
Skip the mock exams entirely to save time
Skip Domain 3 since it's the last one covered
Study only the traps lesson and nothing else
questions.explain: Mock exams under time pressure are what actually reveal readiness — skipping them just moves that discovery to exam day.

questions.q: What is a 'wrong-answer log,' as described in this lesson?
options: A running list of missed practice questions and why, built up across every practice set
A record of which workspace roles exist in Fabric
The official Microsoft exam score report
A list of Fabric item types that sound similar
questions.explain: The wrong-answer log accumulates across Weeks 1-3 and becomes the specific material to re-drill before the Week 4 mock exams.
